about.heading: About
about.bio1: Ahmad Safril Mubah is Vice Dean and Lecturer at the Department of International Relations, Faculty of Social and Political Sciences (FISIP), Universitas Airlangga. He holds a Ph.D. in Asia Pacific Studies from National Chengchi University (Taiwan) and specialises in the geopolitics of the Indo-Pacific, US–China strategic competition, soft power, and the dynamics of terrorism in the era of globalisation.
about.bio2: His research has been published in leading peer-reviewed journals including Issues and Studies and the Journal of Marine and Island Cultures, and has been cited over 560 times across Google Scholar and Scopus. He is a reviewer for Jurnal Hubungan Internasional and a researcher affiliated with Cakra Studi Global Strategis at FISIP UNAIR.
